Range 30 feet

Duration constant

At the end of each of your turns, each hostile construct within range takes a cumulative -1 status penalty to AC and to attack rolls, to a maximum of -4, and each magical ward, barrier, or protective effect within range that has a duration reduces that duration by 1 round. This requires no action and continues whether or not you are aware of it. The penalties end on a construct that leaves your presence for a full round.
